# Onda for Mac 1.1.0 beta 119
## Bluetooth listening and speaker balance
- Include a Bluetooth speaker alongside your main outputs in Room Fill, with a saved independent level. Added-speaker adjustment now runs from −24 to +12 dB, with the existing full-scale output cap and EQ headroom retained. - Desk uses your main speakers for responsive Spotify playback. Room Fill includes saved room speakers; Bluetooth can offer lower delay than AirPlay, depending on the device. - Music returns to the saved listening mode after calls or video. Automatic Video mode is optional in Settings; when enabled, supported playback including Rollside pauses Spotify and the room speaker, then restores them after playback stops. - More robust return intent, receiver-scoped volume history and microphone handling are included from the local 117–118 fixes.
## Verified on the development setup
A Bluetooth Sonos Move and two Studio Displays passed audible Spotify start/track-change checks, muted Google Meet display-only playback, automatic Rollside Play/Pause switching, same-volume return, and a Move power cycle without pressing Connect/Pair or touching Onda. The owner confirmed all three returned with the same balance and no new distinct echo. This does not establish acoustic calibration for every speaker or Mac.
## Settings, compatibility and installation
Existing speaker assignments, levels, room maps and compatible tuning are retained. Original room EQ is saved and bypassed for an incompatible expanded topology; Bluetooth timing uses macOS estimates and manual adjustments. Microphone measurements still require the original supported setup. Positive added-speaker boosts are controlled on the Mac with the submitted iPhone companion; existing phone messages remain decodable.
The bundled driver remains 1.0.5 build 6. Existing users already on that driver do not need a driver update for these Mac app changes. The universal Mac download supports Apple silicon and Intel. Onda Room’s submitted iPhone build is unchanged.
Existing updater-enabled installations receive this release through the signed feed. Automatic checks/downloads follow your settings; installation happens when Onda quits. Calls, video and tuning continue to postpone update checks and explicit restarts.
This is a public beta. Fresh-machine Bluetooth pairing and every speaker model have not been tested. Keep your normal Mac audio output available.
